pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. On which letter does the tone mark go in the syllable liù? (1 mark)
   A. No letter
   B. i
   C. u
   D. l

2. Which tone does mǎ (horse) have? (1 mark)
   A. The first tone, which is flat
   B. The second tone, which rises
   C. The third tone, which dips and rises
   D. The fourth tone, which falls

3. Which of these is the first tone mark? (1 mark)
   A. A rising line, as in á
   B. A flat line, as in ā
   C. A small V, as in ǎ
   D. A falling line, as in à

4. What does 和 (hé) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mother
   B. That
   C. And
   D. Father

5. What does 下 (xià) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bathroom
   B. Where
   C. To put
   D. Under

6. Fill the blank: 电视在桌子____。 (The television is on the table.) (1 mark)
   A. 里
   B. 上
   C. 在
   D. 下

7. In the text 今天是我的生日。朋友们来我家。我很高兴。 what is the main idea? (1 mark)
   A. A trip to the market
   B. A sad day
   C. A lesson at school
   D. A happy birthday with friends

8. Why should we listen kindly when friends explain how they celebrate? (1 mark)
   A. Families celebrate in different ways and all are meaningful
   B. It wastes time
   C. Only one way is right
   D. It is not important

9. Which is a good active listening habit? (1 mark)
   A. Face the speaker and listen for key words
   B. Look at the wall
   C. Talk to your friend
   D. Think about lunch

10. Fill the blank: 我____米饭。 (I eat rice.) (1 mark)
   A. 说
   B. 吃
   C. 听
   D. 喝

11. What does 喝 (hē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Drinks
   B. To eat
   C. To drink
   D. Milk

12. Which Chinese word means "water"? (1 mark)
   A. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   B. 水 shuǐ
   C. 喜欢 xǐhuan
   D. 牛肉 niúròu

13. What does 看 (kàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mouth
   B. Shoulder
   C. To look, to see
   D. To wash hands

14. What does 洪水 (hóngshuǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Also
   B. Not
   C. Very
   D. Flood

15. What does 下雨 (xià yǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wind
   B. There is not
   C. It rains
   D. Weather

16. Which sentence means "The sofa is beside the door."? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发在门旁边。
   B. 床在卧室。
   C. 电视在客厅。
   D. 浴室在花园旁边。

17. What does 同学们 (tóngxuémen) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Teacher
   B. To be called
   C. Hello
   D. Classmates

18. Read the pinyin: zàijiàn! What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. My name is Xiaoming.
   B. Hello, teacher!
   C. Good morning!
   D. Goodbye!

19. What does 老师 (lǎoshī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. And you? (a question word)
   B. You
   C. To be called
   D. Teacher

20. What should you say when giving feedback on someone's reading? (1 mark)
   A. One good thing and one thing to improve
   B. Nothing
   C. Only what was bad
   D. Something unkind

21. What is vocal projection? (1 mark)
   A. Sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting
   B. Reading in a whisper
   C. Reading without tones
   D. Reading very fast

22. Fill the blank: 我们切____。 (We cut the cake.) (1 mark)
   A. 朋友
   B. 快乐
   C. 蛋糕
   D. 礼物

23. What does 朋友 (péngyou) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wish
   B. Month
   C. Date (day of the month)
   D. Friend

24. What does 午饭 (wǔfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Beef
   B. Grapes
   C. Lunch
   D. To eat

25. Which Chinese word means "ear"? (1 mark)
   A. 看 kàn
   B. 牙 yá
   C. 刷牙 shuāyá
   D. 耳朵 ěrduo

26. What does 嘴巴 (zuǐba) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mouth
   B. To wash hands
   C. Ear
   D. To use

27. Fill the blank: 今天____雨。 (Today it rains.) (1 mark)
   A. 上
   B. 好
   C. 下
   D. 在

28. What does 左边 (zuǒbian) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Left side
   B. Sofa
   C. Window
   D. Living room

29. Which sentence means "The sun is very big."? (1 mark)
   A. 太阳很大。
   B. 这是太阳。
   C. 雨很大。
   D. 今天下雨。

30. Which Chinese word means "small"? (1 mark)
   A. 雨 yǔ
   B. 小 xiǎo
   C. 不 bù
   D. 天气 tiānqì

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my older brother." (2 marks)

32. Write the stroke names of 手 in order. (3 marks)

33. Explain the difference between skimming and scanning. (2 marks)

34. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We cut the cake." (2 marks)

35. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my mouth to speak." (2 marks)

36. Write in Chinese with pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." (2 marks)

37. Write the eight basic strokes' names in Chinese with pinyin. Any six earn full marks. (3 marks)

38. Write a five-sentence weather diary for one week in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

39. Name the three parts of a Mandarin syllable. (2 marks)

40. Explain how a good presenter speaks and behaves during a showcase, giving five points. (5 marks)

41. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肩膀, 切 and 去. (3 marks)

42. Give one challenge of writing Chinese and one way to overcome it. (2 marks)

43. What does it mean to listen for gist? Give one way to do it. (2 marks)

44. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!" (2 marks)

45. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: zhè shì xiāngjiāo. (2 marks)

46. Read and translate the chant line: 风来了,雨来了,雪也来了。 (3 marks)

47. Give three ways to make a reading club work well. (3 marks)

48. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: yǔ hěn dà. (2 marks)

49. Name two fruits, one vegetable and one drink in Chinese with pinyin. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — u
   With iu the mark goes on the second vowel, u.

2. C — The third tone, which dips and rises
   The mark ǎ is a small V, which is the dipping third tone.

3. B — A flat line, as in ā
   The first tone is high and level, so its mark is a flat line.

4. C — And
   和 (hé) means and.

5. D — Under
   下 (xià) means under.

6. B — 上
   上 means on.

7. D — A happy birthday with friends
   The text is about a birthday, friends coming and being happy.

8. A — Families celebrate in different ways and all are meaningful
   Respect for different ways of celebrating is important.

9. A — Face the speaker and listen for key words
   Active listeners give the speaker attention and catch the key words.

10. B — 吃
   We eat rice, so we use 吃.

11. C — To drink
   喝 (hē) means to drink.

12. B — 水 shuǐ
   水 (shuǐ) means water.

13. C — To look, to see
   看 (kàn) means to look, to see.

14. D — Flood
   洪水 (hóngshuǐ) means flood.

15. C — It rains
   下雨 (xià yǔ) means it rains.

16. A — 沙发在门旁边。
   沙发在门旁边。 (shāfā zài mén pángbiān.) means "The sofa is beside the door.".

17. D — Classmates
   同学们 (tóngxuémen) means classmates.

18. D — Goodbye!
   zàijiàn! is 再见!, which means "Goodbye!".

19. D — Teacher
   老师 (lǎoshī) means teacher.

20. A — One good thing and one thing to improve
   Kind feedback names a strength and one suggestion.

21. A — Sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting
   Good breathing and an open mouth help you project.

22. C — 蛋糕
   蛋糕 is cake.

23. D — Friend
   朋友 (péngyou) means friend.

24. C — Lunch
   午饭 (wǔfàn) means lunch.

25. D — 耳朵 ěrduo
   耳朵 (ěrduo) means ear.

26. A — Mouth
   嘴巴 (zuǐba) means mouth.

27. C — 下
   下雨 means it rains.

28. A — Left side
   左边 (zuǒbian) means left side.

29. A — 太阳很大。
   太阳很大。 (tàiyáng hěn dà.) means "The sun is very big.".

30. B — 小 xiǎo
   小 (xiǎo) means small.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 那是我哥哥。 nà shì wǒ gēge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for three, 3 marks for all four.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Skimming is reading quickly to get the main idea. Scanning is looking for one particular word or fact.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我们切蛋糕。 wǒmen qiē dàngāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用嘴巴说。 wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: 横 héng, 竖 shù, 撇 piě, 捺 nà, 点 diǎn, 提 tí, 横折 héngzhé, 竖钩 shùgōu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for six or more.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: 星期一,太阳很大。星期二,有云。星期三,下雨。星期四,风很大。星期五,太阳很大。 xīngqīyī, tàiyáng hěn dà. xīngqī'èr, yǒu yún. xīngqīsān, xià yǔ. xīngqīsì, fēng hěn dà. xīngqīwǔ, tàiyáng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each day with weather and pinyin.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: An initial, a final and a tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two parts and 1 mark for all three.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: Stands tall and smiles; looks at the audience; says each word clearly with the right tone; speaks at a steady pace and pauses; stays calm and repeats after a mistake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: 肩膀: jiānbǎng, shoulder. 切: qiē, to cut. 去: qù, to go.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example, remembering stroke order; practise a few characters each day and use flashcards.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Listening for gist means finding the main idea. You can listen for key words you already know.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a method.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is a banana.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fēng lái le, yǔ lái le, xuě yě lái le. The wind has come, the rain has come, the snow has come too.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin, 2 marks for meaning.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be kind and do not laugh at mistakes, listen while others read, take turns fairly and help others who find reading hard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: The rain is heavy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo, 菠菜 bōcài, 茶 chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fruits, 1 mark for vegetable, 1 mark for drink.
